statement: ∀ (A D : ℕ) (T : ℕ→ℝ), (∀ q,0≤T q) → (∑ u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A, ∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D, ((∑ q ∈ (u.gcd v).divisors,T q)*(u:ℝ)⁻¹*(v:ℝ)⁻¹)) ≤ (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min A D),T q*(q:ℝ)⁻¹^2)* (∑ u ∈ Finset.Icc 1 A,(u:ℝ)⁻¹)*(∑ v ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D,(v:ℝ)⁻¹)

plain_statement.zh: 任意非负除数权 T 在不同步长范围 A、D 上的双重公因数除数和，由 q≤min(A,D) 的加权和与两个调和和的乘积控制。
plain_statement.en: The weighted common-divisor sum over distinct positive step ranges A and D is bounded by the q≤min(A,D) weighted inverse-square sum times the two harmonic sums.

brief.zh: 将共同除数求和转成 q|u、q|v 的独立倍数和。推广 PR 2468 的正方形估计到矩形区域，使混合带保留各自步长范围。
brief.en: Factor each common-divisor contribution into two independent sums over multiples. Generalizes the square estimate in PR 2468 to a rectangle, preserving separate step bounds for mixed bands.
